readPolicy: Read the component model of the pinned immutable snapshot through the context resolver: the contexts the document declares (scene-root first, then every component in table order), one context's summary (name, fps, totalFrames, layerCount, instanceCount, exposedPropertyCount, hasCameraKeys), a page of its layers (layerUid, name, layerKind, and the drawing-gate facts visible, locked, parentLayerUid, threeD, hasMotion) and, for a component, a page of the scene layers that instance it in document order. A page holds at most 16 items and is also cut when the next item would exceed the 4096-byte response bound; nextCursor names the first unread index, null at the end; a layer or instance that cannot fit alone is unavailable, but a context whose summary cannot fit alone keeps its id and counts, has its name cut at a character boundary and carries nameTruncated: true, so a listing walks past it. A component record carries no camera keys natively, so its hasCameraKeys is false; the scene reports whether the project camera has keys. Exact atRevision and documentSnapshotId pins are required (a retained older snapshot answers its own pin); any other pin is stale_revision. An undeclared contextId is not_found; instances of scene-root is invalid_request. No mutation, revision publication, read receipt, context entry or mirror: opening a component context is a separate view-state command.

resourceBoundary.policy: Bounded original request bytes and complete correlated response; at most 16 items per page, cut earlier by the response byte bound.

examples.label: Component model of a pinned document; replace example pins with the actual discovery snapshot
